_help: Everything Cedric says on the site. poke = said in order when poked, then loops. chat.replies = what he answers in the chat (in order, then loops); each one comes with the message form. chat.after_sent = answers once the visitor already sent Leon a message. Edit freely, keep the quotes and commas valid. blue_home = what Blue Cédric says when poked on the home page (4th line hints at the secret; the 5th poke shows the 'trip' button). ocean = the secret ocean: all French, whatever the site language.
